metadata.question: Does the wind push ash from Sakurajima first east then south, rathar than first south then east after an eruption on May 21, 2015?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to track ash plume movement from Sakurajima volcano after eruption on May 21, 2015 - Use Sentinel-5P for aerosol data or MODIS for aerosol optical depth - Need multiple time points after May 21, 2015 to track direction - Sakurajima location: ~31.58°N, 130.66°E (Kagoshima, Japan) 2. Masking strategy: - Don't mask clouds - we're tracking ash/aerosol movement - Need aerosol index or AOD to detect ash plume - Look for elevated aerosol values in different directions from volcano 3. Logic: - Compare aerosol patterns in EAST vs SOUTH directions at T1 (first hours/day) - Then compare SOUTH vs EAST at T2 (later period) - Pattern "first east then south" means: East_T1 > South_T1 AND South_T2 > East_T2 - Valid answer (A/B) if we can detect the pattern - C1 if no data available (Sentinel-5P starts 2018, need Terra/Aqua MODIS) - C2 if no aerosol signal detected - C3 if calculation fails ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Sakurajima volcano location const volcano = ee.Geometry.Point([130.66, 31.58]); // Define directional regions (30km from volcano) const eastRegion = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([130.66, 31.48, 131.16, 31.68]); const southRegion = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([130.56, 31.08, 130.76, 31.58]); // 2. Time periods after eruption (May 21, 2015) const t1Start = '2015-05-21'; const t1End = '2015-05-22'; // First day const t2Start = '2015-05-22'; const t2End = '2015-05-24'; // Second-third day // 3. Get Terra MODIS Aerosol data (available from 2000) const aod1 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD08_D3') .filterDate(t1Start, t1End) .select('Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Mean'); const aod2 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD08_D3') .filterDate(t2Start, t2End) .select('Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Mean'); console.log('T1 Images:', aod1.size().getInfo()); console.log('T2 Images:', aod2.size().getInfo()); if (aod1.size().getInfo() === 0 || aod2.size().getInfo() === 0) { // Try Aqua MODIS as backup const aod1_aqua = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD08_D3') .filterDate(t1Start, t1End) .select('Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Mean'); const aod2_aqua = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD08_D3') .filterDate(t2Start, t2End) .select('Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Mean'); console.log('Aqua T1 Images:', aod1_aqua.size().getInfo()); console.log('Aqua T2 Images:', aod2_aqua.size().getInfo()); if (aod1_aqua.size().getInfo() === 0 || aod2_aqua.size().getInfo() === 0) { console.log('No aerosol data available for eruption period'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 4. Calculate mean AOD for each region and time const img1 = aod1.mean(); const img2 = aod2.mean(); const east_t1_stats = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: eastRegion, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const south_t1_stats = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: southRegion, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const east_t2_stats = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: eastRegion, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const south_t2_stats = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: southRegion, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const east_t1 = east_t1_stats['Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Mean_mean']; const south_t1 = south_t1_stats['Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Mean_mean']; const east_t2 = east_t2_stats['Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Mean_mean']; const south_t2 = south_t2_stats['Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Mean_mean']; const count_e1 = east_t1_stats['Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Mean_count']; const count_s1 = south_t1_stats['Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Mean_count']; const count_e2 = east_t2_stats['Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Mean_count']; const count_s2 = south_t2_stats['Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Mean_count']; console.log('East T1 (May 21-22): AOD=' + (east_t1 || 'null') + ', Pixels=' + count_e1); console.log('South T1 (May 21-22): AOD=' + (south_t1 || 'null') + ', Pixels=' + count_s1); console.log('East T2 (May 22-24): AOD=' + (east_t2 || 'null') + ', Pixels=' + count_e2); console.log('South T2 (May 22-24): AOD=' + (south_t2 || 'null') + ', Pixels=' + count_s2); // 5. Validation if (!count_e1 || !count_s1 || !count_e2 || !count_s2) { console.log('No valid pixels in one or more regions'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (east_t1 === null || south_t1 === null || east_t2 === null || south_t2 === null) { console.log('Calculation failed - null values'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 6. Determine direction pattern const first_east = east_t1 > south_t1; const then_south = south_t2 > east_t2; console.log('First East (T1):', first_east, '(E=' + east_t1.toFixed(4) + ' vs S=' + south_t1.toFixed(4) + ')'); console.log('Then South (T2):', then_south, '(S=' + south_t2.toFixed(4) + ' vs E=' + east_t2.toFixed(4) + ')'); if (first_east && then_south) { console.log('Pattern: First East, Then South'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Pattern does not match "first east then south"'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
